notes: 2026-10-20 (Alex): hongjiacheng's SRV05-4A (C20615829, Preferred at JLC: no setup fee) replaced Semtech's SRV05-4.TCT (C13612, Extended), which had replaced ProTek's SRV05-4-P-T7 (C85364) on 2026-10-07. Same pinout as both (p1 Function Diagram: I/O on 1, 3, 4, 6; 2 the ground; 5 the positive reference, the 'V05' rail), same SOT-23-6 package.
Its JLC library footprint and CPL rotation weren't checked against C13612's: confirm U1's orientation in JLC's placement preview (validation_plan #8).
REF tied to +3V3 rather than VBUS (a deliberate design choice, as with Semtech's part).
Package: p3 outline SOT23-6L: A 2.80-3.00, B 2.60-3.00, E 1.50-1.70, J 1.00-1.20 mm; fits Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23-6.
Against Semtech's: surge 4 A (8/20 us) against 12 A, which doesn't matter on USB data lines in a cell-powered handheld; ESD 15 kV contact against Semtech's 8 kV.
